items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: By the L, Mr. Turn, going north.

ctx.x: He played with him. I got the picture. And the magazine, man. Oh, yeah? Licking with the women on the floor and all, man. Bix, man. Yeah. Old Bix, man. Yeah. Old Bix, but I got a scene with him. I got a scene with him, man. On Wabash and 12th Street. You know, they called it 12th Street and Roseville Road. They used to the old Greyhound station there. And of course, they had the old Roseville Hotel. And then Michigan Avenue one block over. They had about five blocks. So, from the Fry's Inn and Wabash and Van…
I know she goes pretty good.
